## Summary

**Rewrite verbose panel body copy**

Long paragraphs combine status, scope, caveat and instructions.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P2**
- Wave: **V3**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P2-01`
- DUX code: `DUX5-20`

## Scope

Run Explorer, DQ handoffs, Incident impact, Trust latency/help.

Screenshot groups: SG-01, SG-02, SG-03, SG-07 verbose bodies

## Concrete change

Split into STATUS, REASON, IMPACT, ACTION, SCOPE, FRESHNESS; cap main body at 2–4 lines.

## Expected effect

Lower reading time and fewer missed actions.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every primary card passes a 5-second comprehension review; help text is outside the primary body.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

UX copy review with SRE/domain owners.

## Risk

Shortening can remove necessary caveats; retain them in description/runbook.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Copy rewrite pass once status cards exist.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

DUX5 epic (#7116)
